name: distribution-pro
description: Distribution Pro — Wholesale & FMCG Distribution ERP (POS billing, carton+loose units, batches & FEFO, sales/purchase returns, order booking, van sales & settlement, schemes & claims, credit limit lock, cheque/PDC register, receipts with FIFO allocation, salesmen commissions, cash closing, 32 reports). Runs offline on Node.js with zero required dependencies.
